_doc: JobBench action runtime (App. A.4). max_turns: Stirrup turn cap of every action; loop_in_phase_max_turns: turn cap of each Loop-In phase. turn_warning_threshold, context_summarization_cutoff, shell_timeout_seconds: Stirrup settings. stakeholder_pre_output_calls / stakeholder_post_output_calls: code_exec calls a stakeholder or Loop-In phase may make before / after its output file exists; worker actions have no call ceiling. retrieval_splits: task subsets whose worker gets the guarded web tools (main on, easy off; stakeholders never). search_model, search_thinking_level, search_timeout_seconds: the grounded search call, at temperature 0. fetch_timeout_seconds: fetch and download. search_limit, fetch_limit, download_limit, download_byte_limit, max_download_file_bytes: per worker action: 16 searches, 32 fetches, 16 downloads, 1 GiB in total, 512 MiB per file.
